mapper.sql: select wf.form_id , wf.create_time as form_create_time , wf.current_org_id , wf.tenant_id , ssc.service_contract_id , ssc.create_time as contract_create_time , ssc.amount , ssc.service_unit from wf_form wf left join sc_service_contract ssc on ssc.flag = 1 and ssc.form_id = wf.form_id where wf.flag = 1
mapper.select: with vc as ( ) select '投诉类型占比' as stat_desc, '' as stat_dim, stat_name, '件' as stat_unit, '进度慢' as item_name, count(case when instr(subject, '进度慢') > 0 then 1 end) as item_val from vc group by stat_name union all select '投诉类型占比' as stat_desc, '' as stat_dim, stat_name, '件' as stat_unit, '质量差' as item_name, count(case when instr(subject, '质量差') > 0 then 1 end) as item_val from vc group by stat_name union all select '投诉类型占比' as stat_desc, '' as stat_dim, stat_name, '件' as stat_unit, '态度恶劣' as item_name, count(case when instr(subject, '态度恶劣') > 0 then 1 end) as item_val from vc group by stat_name union all select '投诉类型占比' as stat_desc, '' as stat_dim, stat_name, '%' as stat_unit, '进度慢' as item_name, round(count(case when instr(subject, '进度慢') > 0 then 1 end) / count(1) * 100, 2) as item_val from vc group by stat_name union all select '投诉类型占比' as stat_desc, '' as stat_dim, stat_name, '%' as stat_unit, '质量差' as item_name, round(count(case when instr(subject, '质量差') > 0 then 1 end) / count(1) * 100, 2) as item_val from vc group by stat_name union all select '投诉类型占比' as stat_desc, '' as stat_dim, stat_name, '%' as stat_unit, '态度恶劣' as item_name, round(count(case when instr(subject, '态度恶劣') > 0 then 1 end) / count(1) * 100, 2) as item_val from vc group by stat_name
